name: Antec CX700 RGB Elite Black Case + Antec CSK Pro 850W ATX 3.1 80+ Bronze Power Supply
shortDescription: Antec CX700 RGB Elite Black Mid Tower Gaming Case + Antec CSK Pro 850W 80 Plus Bronze ATX 3.1 / PCIe 5.1 Power Supply Bundle (Panoramic Tempered Glass / 3x Pre-Installed Fixed Mode RGB Fans / PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 Cable / 5-Y
descriptionHtml:
Antec CX700 RGB Elite Black Mid Tower Gaming Case + Antec CSK Pro 850W 80 Plus Bronze ATX 3.1 / PCIe 5.1 Power Supply Bundle (Panoramic Tempered Glass / 3x Pre-Installed Fixed Mode RGB Fans / PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 Cable / 5-Year Warranty)

Upgrade your gaming build with this ultimate power combo available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 5-Year Warranty (ضمان 5 سنوات). Featuring the Antec CX700 RGB Elite Black Mid Tower Case with dual-chamber panoramic glass design and 6 pre-installed RGB fans, paired with the high-performance Antec CSK Pro 850W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply certified with ATX 3.1 and native PCIe 5.0 / PCIe 5.1 support for modern high-end graphics cards.
